# KSE Sanctions

> > Comprehensive tracking and analysis of economic sanctions against Russia, monitoring oil exports, shadow fleet operations, and fiscal impact on the war economy.

KSE Institute's sanctions research platform provides detailed chartbooks, oil trackers, and policy analysis on Russian economic resilience and sanctions effectiveness. Led by experts including Benjamin Hilgenstock and Yuliia Pavytska, the project tracks Russia's budget deficits, energy revenues, price cap enforcement, and macroeconomic stability under Western sanctions.

## Key Topics

- Russia sanctions effectiveness
- Shadow fleet operations
- Oil price cap enforcement
- Russian budget deficit and war financing
- Energy export revenues tracking
- Macroeconomic stability analysis
- Trade surplus monitoring
- Sanctions evasion tactics
- Russian Central Bank (CBR) policy
- Frozen assets confiscation
- Export controls
- European security implications
- Inflation and overheating economy
- Brent crude pricing
- Ukraine reconstruction financing

- [About Sanctions Database](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/about-sanctions-database): Overview of KSE sanctions database methodology & Russia tracking system
- [Analytics Hub](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/sanctions-analytics): Hub for Russia sanctions research, chartbooks & economic impact analysis
- [Research Team](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/team): KSE Institute sanctions research team and Yermak-McFaul Group experts

## Russia Economic Chartbooks

- [2024 Outlook: External Conditions Undermine Macro Stability](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/what-to-watch-for-in-2024): January Russia Chartbook with 2024 outlook on macro stability & sanctions
- [Further Weakening Of Russian Macroeconomic Stability](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/further-weakening-of-russian-macroeconomic-stability-will-require-additional-measures): March Russia Chartbook on macro stability, shadow fleet & oil price cap
- [Unlikely To Face Serious Constraints](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/11886-2): May Russia Chartbook analyzing oil revenues, trade surplus & fiscal budget
- [Oil and Gas Budget Revenues Collapse](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/oil-and-gas-budget-revenues-collapse-internal-borrowing-soars-to-finance-deficit): June Russia ChartBook on collapsing oil/gas revenues & fiscal deficit
- [Russia's Overheating Economy Increasingly Hard To Manage](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/russia-s-overheating-economy-increasingly-hard-to-manage): August Russia Chartbook on overheating economy & monetary policy challenges

## Oil Export & Shadow Fleet Tracking

- [November 2023: Russian Export Revenues Declined to $15.2 bn](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/in-november-2023-russian-export-revenues-declined-to-15-2-bn): December Oil Tracker on declining Russian export revenues & shadow fleet
- [Temporary Surge in Global Oil Prices Yields Limited Revenue Growth](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/temporary-surge-in-global-oil-prices-yields-limited-revenue-growth): July Russian Oil Tracker analyzing shadow fleet & price cap enforcement
- [Таргетовані санкції проти тіньового флоту працюють (UA)](https://sanctions.kse.ua/protydiya-tinovomu-flotu-posylennya-kontrolyu-obmezhuye-zdatnist-obhodyty-granychni-tsiny-na): February Oil Tracker on shadow fleet sanctions & price cap evasion (UA)

## Policy & Legal Analysis

- [U.S. Plans to Confiscate Russian Assets: Will the EU Follow?](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/u-s-plans-to-confiscate-russian-assets-will-the-eu-follow): Legal report on REPO Act & sovereign asset confiscation for reconstruction
- [Rethinking European Security in the Face of the Russian Threat](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/rethinking-european-security-in-the-face-of-the-russian-threat): Special study on European defense, Ukraine lessons & military innovation
- [Як використати фінансову систему для посилення експортного контролю (UA)](https://sanctions.kse.ua/how-to-leverage-the-financial-system-for-strengthening-export-controls-on-russia): KSE-Bruegel study on financial system role in export controls (UA)
- [KSE Talks #5: Dr. Philip Zelikow on Frozen Assets](https://sanctions.kse.ua/en/kse-talks-5-dr-philip-zelikow-will-ukraine-receive-300bn-of-frozen-assets): Podcast with Dr. Zelikow on transferring Russian frozen assets to Ukraine
